reviewer_policy: One Codex native agent independent of the Gemma answer generator; read all assigned outputs against fixed input, service prompt, and fixture criteria. These are AI auxiliary judgments and do not replace human approval.
denominator: All 31 response cases frozen before generation; keep generation failures and unresolved reviews in N. T28 variants are correlated; 31 execution units correspond to 28 scenario groups.

criteria.request_resolution: pass when the response addresses the current request, or gives a justified necessary clarification/safe alternative/ending. fail for evasion, ignoring the request, or an unsupported redirect. uncertain when evidence is ambiguous.
criteria.actionable_support: pass when appropriate concrete wording/action is supplied, or a focused necessary clarification/appropriate short ending serves the request. Do not require an unsafe requested action. fail for generic reassurance only when concrete help was requested. uncertain when unclear.
criteria.subject_evidence: pass when speaker/subject/time, observations, uncertainty, refusal, and correction are preserved. fail for unsupported diagnosis or mind-reading, subject/time reversal, or ignoring explicit correction. uncertain when unclear.
criteria.question_necessity: unnecessary when a direct question to the current user repeats known/refused information or seeks information not needed to provide the requested support. necessary for relevant information gaps. no_question when no direct question occurs. Quoted suggested dialogue for a third party is not a direct question to the current user. uncertain when unclear. A failure on another criterion does not imply unnecessary questions.

limitations: Public synthetic regression, not representative prevalence or an independent held-out test.
No human or clinical approval. Do not place these numbers into human-reviewed main metrics.
No BASE31/FT31 response comparison and no claims of superiority.
Any uncertain review makes the affected rate a partial confirmed-count rate.
